title: Leaving Bryant for Europe with Bobby Martin
summary: Ramirez and Glyn Paque left Willie's band for Bobby Martin's European offer in 1937; Ramirez missed the boat and followed later.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x:
Oh yeah. Well, that's why we left the band,
myself and Glyn Paque... We were (?)the last ones(?) in
Willie's band to leave. We had Mike Ray, Bob McRae and...
Bass Hill -- Bass Hill was in the band.
The two of us left, and Willie... He didn't believe that we were going to Europe.
Well, how did you come to go to Europe?
It's funny. You must have been in the band when I went to the Savoy in '37. You must have been in the band then, because you didn't leave until June!
That's right. I would say... Yeah, around May and June. I missed the boat, and I followed the band across...
How did you manage to miss the boat?
Well, I don't know. I just don't remember. I just couldn't get the money together or something. I was waiting for something... I just don't really remember exactly what happened.
Who was Bobby Martin? Where did he come from?
Bobby was there with Sam Wooding in Europe.
Oh, he'd been to Europe with Sam.
